widths.note: 60' from the top of the freight house south; the part from Harrison down to the freight house is labelled 30'

bends.note: Harrison turns from ENE-WSW (about 25 deg) to nearly due west, west of the B. & O. S-W. tracks, and runs off the west edge toward Mill Creek
Willow runs due north-south below here and turns NNW (about 25 deg) up to Harrison

ends.note: west end at the Mill Creek bank

notes: Mostly railroad land; few streets. Garrard Avenue jogs: the 30' north part (Harrison to the freight house, centre x~3478, water pipe on its centre) is offset east of the 60' south part (west line = the C.C.C. & St. L. freight house wall, centre x~3368 at the top, ~3327 at Bank). Duck Street (printed 'DUCK (NOT IMPROVED)') leaves Garrard to the SE; its centreline meets the Garrard south-part centreline right at the jog (3368,2796). McRoberts Street (named on sheet 222, ~40 ft, no width printed) leaves Duck to the NE at (4981,5105); the lines on the SW side of Duck are single lot lines, so it is a T. Duck runs SE into the binding at the bottom right: its junction with Bank Street lies past the page edge and is not recorded; a '60'' label sits beside the 1400/1012 corner there, unclear which street it belongs to. Bank Street starts at Garrard (the block west of Garrard continues south), so Bank/Garrard is a T; Bank's south line is right at the bottom edge of the drawing, centre taken as north line + 25 ft. Willow north of its bend: the east line (2178 side) is clean, but the 1355/2179 building on the west side is drawn standing inside the 60' street, so the centreline there was taken as the east line offset by 30 ft. Willow/Harrison uses the Harrison water pipe as the Harrison centreline (it sits midway between the street lines). 'STATION' is a street (60'), Mill Creek to Willow. Railroad tracks, the trestle and the freight platform are ignored.
